mapper.select: -- 고객사 관리 목록을 조회한다. SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.contact_position, c.phone, c.email, c.memo, c.is_active, COALESCE(oc.opportunity_count, 0) AS opportunity_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(1) AS opportunity_count FROM opportunities o WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id ) oc ON oc.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY c.is_active DESC, c.name, c.customer_id

-- 고객사 상세 정보를 조회한다. SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.contact_position, c.phone, c.email, c.memo, c.is_active, COALESCE(oc.opportunity_count, 0) AS opportunity_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(1) AS opportunity_count FROM opportunities o WHERE o.customer_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.customer_id ) oc ON oc.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId}
-- 영업 사이트 등록에서 선택한 활성 고객사 상세를 조회한다. SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.phone FROM customers c WHERE c.customer_id = #{customerId} AND c.is_active = TRUE
-- 영업 사이트 등록에서 선택 가능한 활성 고객사 목록을 조회한다. SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, c.contact_name, c.phone FROM customers c WHERE c.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY c.name, c.customer_id
mapper.insert: -- 신규 고객사를 등록한다. INSERT INTO customers ( name, contact_name, contact_position, phone, email, memo, is_active, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{contactName}, #{contactPosition}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{memo}, #{active}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: -- 고객사 기본 정보를 수정한다. UPDATE customers SET name = #{name}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_position = #{contactPosition}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, memo = #{memo}, is_active = #{active}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{customerId}
